malware_hash_match.reason: The app's APK matches a known malware hash.

sideloaded.reason: Installed from outside an app store.

accessibility_enabled.reason: Has an accessibility service turned on, which can read the screen and tap for it.

device_admin.reason: Registered as a device admin, which gives it strong control over the phone.

no_launcher_icon.reason: Has no launcher icon, so it is hidden from the app list.

risky_permission:SEND_SMS.reason: Can send text messages, which can cost money.

risky_permission:SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.reason: Can draw over other apps, which is used to fake login screens.

risky_permission:BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERV.reason: Declares an accessibility service, which can read the screen and tap for it.

combos.name: banking_trojan_pattern
combos.reason: Sideloaded app that can read SMS and use accessibility. This is the classic banking trojan pattern.
